inspiration.observed_pattern: A view joins descriptive parent data to a derived relation that groups association rows by two keys and computes a SUM for each pair.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independent operator-cluster score view. A derived aggregate groups fixed link weights by operator and cluster, then the view joins operator handles; the source schema, names, values, and application context are new.

fixture_notes: Operator 11 has two links to cluster 3 and one link to cluster 8, so both grouped totals are visible; operator 12 has duplicate links to cluster 3; operator 13 has no links and must not appear in the inner-joined view. The final read exposes aggregate totals through the view rather than querying the source tables directly.
determinism_notes: Operator IDs, cluster IDs, link weights, view columns, and final ordering are fixed; there are no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules.
setup: CREATE TABLE review_operators (operator_id INT PRIMARY KEY, operator_handle VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE)
CREATE TABLE cluster_links (link_id INT PRIMARY KEY, operator_id INT NOT NULL, cluster_id INT NOT NULL, weight INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW operator_cluster_scores AS SELECT o.operator_handle, grouped.cluster_id, grouped.total_weight FROM (SELECT operator_id, cluster_id, SUM(weight) AS total_weight FROM cluster_links GROUP BY operator_id, cluster_id) AS grouped INNER JOIN review_operators AS o ON o.operator_id = grouped.operator_id
SELECT operator_handle, cluster_id, total_weight FROM operator_cluster_scores ORDER BY operator_handle, cluster_id
